items._unverified_reason: Single-source (CalorieKing AU) since KFC's own site is unreachable from this environment (bot-protected, blocked every fetch method tried). Cross-checked against FatSecret AU: a standardized item (Zinger Fillet Burger, 434 vs 448 cal) matched within normal variance, but this single-piece item didn't (459 vs 390 cal, and sodium/protein diverged beyond what the different reference weights explain) -- likely because a loose fried-chicken piece's real weight varies far more than a packaged/composed item, and different sources define their 'average' piece differently. Needs a source that states its reference weight explicitly before this can be resolved.
